supersedes.reason: The v1 parser rejected documented cross-chunk boundary repeats even when byte-level opens agreed; v1 produced no result and its five products are opened and excluded from v2.

sources.claim: Original crypto study compares fixed-weight daily and monthly rebalancing with buy-and-hold.
Adversarial prior: optimal rebalance frequency is not universal and depends on autocorrelation and expected-return dispersion.
Official endpoint defines time as bucket start, caps responses at 300 and may return candles preceding start or omit no-tick intervals.

provider.timestamp_semantics: UTC bucket start; use each bucket open as the first trade of that UTC day
provider.overlap_rule: deduplicate a repeated UTC bucket only when its open is exactly equal; fail on conflict

data.selection_rule: fresh fixed currently available non-stablecoin USD spot products selected before v2 outcomes; all five v1 products prohibited
data.missing_bucket_rule: fail unless every UTC date in the closed window has one common nonconflicting daily open for every product

portfolio.strategy: reset to 20 percent per product at the first UTC daily open of each calendar month, then let weights drift
portfolio.benchmark: 20 percent per product at the first window open, then buy and hold with drifting weights
portfolio.initial_purchase_cost: same initial allocation on both sleeves and excluded from active difference
portfolio.turnover: one_way half-L1 distance from pre-rebalance drifting weights to equal weights

costs.application: charge strategy rebalance turnover only; buy-and-hold has no post-initial trades

trial_accounting.selection_rule: no universe, frequency, dates, costs, folds, seed, missing-data, overlap or gate changes after any v2 product candle byte
